subject: Vendor activation — HoloGrid invoicing lane & early-remit coordination
messages:
From: Anya Lopez <anya.lopez@hologrid.io>

Subject: Vendor activation: HoloGrid invoice lane and early payment options

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call this week — excited to get HoloGrid set up as a Redwood vendor. Attaching our completed onboarding form and W-9 to this message. A couple of items to confirm so we can align with our AP: 

- Billing cadence: We typically invoice monthly and prefer Net 30, but can accept Net 45 on a transitional basis. Please confirm which cycle Redwood needs for the initial quarter.
- PO mapping: Will Redwood send a dedicated PO per project or a standing PO? We need to know the PO number placement for automated invoice ingestion.
- Early payment: HoloGrid would be open to an early payment program if you offer it — what discount rate and timing do you typically offer for 15-day/30-day accelerated remit?
- Remit details: We'll attach bank info in a follow-up if helpful; likewise let us know preferred invoice email or vendor portal link.

Attachments: HoloGrid_onboarding_form.pdf (fillable), W9_HoloGrid.pdf

Can we aim to have the vendor record live by next Wednesday (2026-04-15)? Happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Anya Lopez
Head of Finance Operations
HoloGrid Inc.

Thanks Anya — looping Marissa (commercial) and Rishi (finance) to lock down terms. Quick notes / asks from our side: 

- Preferred cadence: Redwood's standard is Net 45 for new vendors by default (for alignment with our consolidated billing cycles), but we can escalate to Net 30 if it's commercially required. Marissa, can you weigh in on where we land here?
- PO process: Procurement needs to know whether HoloGrid expects a PO per engagement. If so, please confirm the expected PO field format (e.g., PO-XXXX) so we can map to our AP automation.
- Required docs: We need the completed onboarding form (received), W-9 (received), and bank details for ACH. Please also confirm authorized signatory for invoices.
- Early-pay pilot: We occasionally run an early-remit program — typical finance offer is 1-2% discount for settlement within 10–15 days. Rishi, can you confirm the pilot terms we can extend here (rate and max cap)?

Marissa — can you take point on commercial (Net30 vs Net45) and confirm if we can provide a 1.5% early-pay option at 15 days capped at $50k for a first pilot? If yes, I'll trigger the vendor profile and PO lane mapping.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Procurement (Interim)
Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — quick responses below: 

- PO per engagement: We prefer a PO per project; our AP system requires the PO number in the invoice header (Invoice -> PO#: 8-digit). That's workable for us.
- Remit details: Attached bank info (HoloGrid_bank_info.pdf). We can accept ACH only.
- Billing cadence: We can do Net 45 for Q2 onboarding, but prefer Net 30 ongoing. If Redwood needs Net 45 for an initial onboarding window, we can accept that.
- Early-pay: We're interested — 1.5% @ 15 days sounds reasonable. We would need to cap per-invoice discount logic or a monthly cap; happy to pilot a $50k monthly cap.

Next steps: please share the vendor portal link (or remit-to email) and a template PO layout so we can validate mapping. We'll also start supplier portal registration and can provide bank confirmation via test ACH if needed.

Hi Anya — great, thanks for the clarity. Confirming plan and MAP (mutual action plan):

1) Terms: Redwood will onboard HoloGrid on Net 45 for the first month (to align with our billing cutoff), then move to Net 30 on 2026-05-15 pending successful invoice ingestion.

2) Early-pay pilot: Finance approves a 1.5% discount for settlement at 15 days, capped at $50k/month for the first 90 days. Rishi will validate payment flow and cap enforcement.

3) PO & Invoice mapping: We'll send a sample PO template and a vendor portal invite by EOD tomorrow. Please ensure the PO#: field lands in the invoice header exactly as 'PO#: 8-digit' for automated matching.

4) Attachments & verification: Received onboarding form, W-9, and bank info. Procurement will run standard KYC checks; expect a quick verification email. If you can trigger a $0.01 micro-ACH test, that will speed validation.

5) Owner & timeline: Marissa (commercial) owns terms confirmation; Hannah will provision the vendor record; Rishi owns the early-pay pilot setup and accounting classification. Target: vendor live and first PO accepted by 2026-04-21.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-hologrid-onboarding (onboarding docs), HubSpot HG-2026-04-11-12
